description: Clock standards & lint compliance baseline for the 'no new debt' CI gate.
note: This baseline is used by .github/workflows/ci.yml. The CI fails ONLY if a PR regresses these numbers (i.e. makes compliance worse). Reducing them is the goal. Updated to reflect current fleet size (498 clocks) and current error counts after fixing all TS errors and running ESLint --fix. Lint errors reduced from 577→384. TypeScript errors are now 0.
